result.reason: The redline appropriately extends coverage to Affiliates and contractors and removes at-will revocability, while preserving the use restrictions. However, it permits termination whenever the Agreement or applicable attachment terminates, rather than limiting termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. It also does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or permit transfer to an M&A successor. The margin comment does not cure these operative omissions.
